final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS w, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM s1) SELECT s1.w, s1.a, s1.c, s1.a - s2.b FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL
